```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%",
  dpi = 150
)

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

required <- c("DBI", "RSQLite", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "sf", "knitr", "scales", "jsonlite")
missing <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Packages R manquants : ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

# ---------- Fichiers et données ----------
db_candidates <- c(
  params$db_file,
  file.path(getwd(), "input", "tvd_datawarehouse.sqlite"),
  file.path(getwd(), "..", "input", "tvd_datawarehouse.sqlite")
)
db_candidates <- unique(db_candidates[!is.na(db_candidates) & nzchar(db_candidates)])
db_candidates <- db_candidates[file.exists(db_candidates)]
if (!length(db_candidates)) stop("Base SQLite introuvable. Renseignez params$db_file.")
db_file <- normalizePath(db_candidates[1], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

table_name <- as.character(params$table_name %||% "final_analysis_database")
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db_file)
read_tables <- tryCatch({
  if (!DBI::dbExistsTable(con, table_name)) {
    stop("La table SQLite `", table_name, "` n'existe pas dans ", db_file, ".")
  }
  list(
    data = DBI::dbReadTable(con, table_name),
    countries = tryCatch(DBI::dbReadTable(con, "localisation"), error = function(e) NULL)
  )
}, finally = DBI::dbDisconnect(con))
raw_data <- read_tables$data
country_lookup <- read_tables$countries

find_column <- function(data, candidates) {
  found <- intersect(candidates, names(data))
  if (length(found)) found[1] else NULL
}
get_text <- function(data, candidates, default = "") {
  col <- find_column(data, candidates)
  if (is.null(col)) rep(default, nrow(data)) else as.character(data[[col]])
}
get_numeric <- function(data, candidates, default = NA_real_) {
  col <- find_column(data, candidates)
  if (is.null(col)) return(rep(default, nrow(data)))
  x <- trimws(as.character(data[[col]]))
  x <- gsub("\\s", "", x)
  x <- gsub(",", ".", x, fixed = TRUE)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# ---------- Harmonisation ----------
df <- data.frame(
  source = get_text(raw_data, c("indicator_ref_data", "source"), "Non renseignée"),
  category = get_text(raw_data, c("indicator_category_indicator", "indicator_category", "category_indicator"), "Non catégorisé"),
  component = get_text(raw_data, c("indicator_component_name", "component"), "Non renseignée"),
  disease = get_text(raw_data, c("indicator_disease_name", "disease_name", "disease"), "Maladie non renseignée"),
  indicator_code = get_text(raw_data, c("dictionary_indicator_code", "indicator_code")),
  indicator = get_text(raw_data, c("dictionary_indicator_name", "indicator_name", "label_indicator")),
  performance = get_text(raw_data, c("indicator_performance_indicator")),
  ntd_all_ages_ntd_female = get_numeric(raw_data, "ntd_all_ages_ntd_female"),
  ntd_all_ages_ntd_male = get_numeric(raw_data, "ntd_all_ages_ntd_male"),
  ntd_all_ages_ntd_unknown_both_sexes = get_numeric(raw_data, "ntd_all_ages_ntd_unknown_both_sexes"),
  year = get_text(raw_data, c("period", "year", "time_dim")),
  country = get_text(raw_data, c("country_name", "organisation_unit", "country", "location")),
  country_iso = get_text(raw_data, c("country_iso", "ISO3", "iso3")),
  kind = tolower(trimws(get_text(raw_data, c("gnarf_type", "indicator_type_indicator")))),
  status = get_text(raw_data, c(
    "status_endemicite", "status_endemicity", "endemicity_status",
    "endemicity", "endem_status", "indicator_endemicity", "status_raw"
  )),
  value = get_numeric(raw_data, c("all_cases", "total_value", "value", "numeric_value")),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

for (nm in c("source", "category", "component", "disease", "indicator", "country")) {
  df[[nm]][is.na(df[[nm]]) | !nzchar(trimws(df[[nm]]))] <- "Non renseigné"
}
df$indicator_code[is.na(df$indicator_code) | !nzchar(trimws(df$indicator_code))] <- "Sans code"
df$year_numeric <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trimws(df$year)))
df$is_endemicity <- grepl("endemic|endém", trimws(df$indicator), ignore.case = TRUE) |
  df$kind %in% c("endemicite", "endemicity", "endémicité")
df$endemicity_status <- trimws(df$status)
df$endemicity_status[tolower(df$endemicity_status) %in% c("", "not applicable", "na", "n/a")] <- NA_character_
df$is_endemicity <- df$is_endemicity | (!is.na(df$endemicity_status) & nzchar(df$endemicity_status))

classify_status <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^yes, country is endemic", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Endémique",
    grepl("^no, country is not endemic", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Non endémique",
    grepl("^no, country is known to be endemic", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Endémique, surveillance indisponible",
    grepl("^yes, country is not endemic", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Non endémique, surveillance rapportée",
    grepl("^never endemic", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Jamais endémique",
    !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(x)) ~ "Statut non classé",
    TRUE ~ "Non renseigné"
  )
}
df$endemicity_class <- classify_status(df$endemicity_status)

# ---------- Filtres ----------
filters <- params$filters
if (is.null(filters)) filters <- list()
filter_columns <- list(
  source = "source", category = "category", disease = "disease",
  indicator = "indicator", country = "country", year = "year"
)
apply_product_filters <- function(data, product) {
  selected_filters <- filters[[product]]
  if (is.null(selected_filters) || !length(selected_filters)) return(data)
  for (key in names(selected_filters)) {
    col <- filter_columns[[key]]
    selected <- as.character(selected_filters[[key]])
    if (!is.null(col) && col %in% names(data) && length(selected)) {
      data <- data[as.character(data[[col]]) %in% selected, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
  data
}
df_table <- apply_product_filters(df, "table")
df_trend <- apply_product_filters(df, "trend")
df_geo <- apply_product_filters(df, "geo")
df_endemicity <- apply_product_filters(df, "endemicity")

# ---------- Utilitaires ----------
report_progress_update <- function(value, detail) {
  if (exists("report_progress", mode = "function", inherits = TRUE)) {
    get("report_progress", mode = "function", inherits = TRUE)(value, detail)
  }
}
fmt_num <- function(x, accuracy = 1) {

  res <- scales::number(
    x,
    accuracy = accuracy,
    big.mark = " ",
    decimal.mark = ","
  )

  res[is.na(x)] <- "—"

  res
}
fmt_pct <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "—", paste0(fmt_num(x, 0.1), " %"))
}
safe_max_year <- function(x) {
  z <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(z)) NA_real_ else max(z)
}
slugify <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  x <- tolower(gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]+", "_", x))
  gsub("(^_+|_+$)", "", x)
}
normalize_country <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(trimws(as.character(x)), from = "", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  toupper(trimws(gsub("[^A-Z0-9]+", " ", x)))
}

shape_candidates <- c(
  params$shape_file,
  file.path(getwd(), "input", "shapefile", "country_simplified.gpkg"),
  file.path(getwd(), "..", "input", "shapefile", "country_simplified.gpkg")
)
shape_candidates <- unique(shape_candidates[!is.na(shape_candidates) & nzchar(shape_candidates)])
shape_candidates <- shape_candidates[file.exists(shape_candidates)]
shape_file <- if (length(shape_candidates)) shape_candidates[1] else ""

get_map_shape <- function() {
  if (!nzchar(shape_file)) return(NULL)
  layer <- if (grepl("\\.gpkg$", shape_file, ignore.case = TRUE)) "AFRICA" else NULL
  shp <- tryCatch(
    if (is.null(layer)) sf::st_read(shape_file, quiet = TRUE) else sf::st_read(shape_file, layer = layer, quiet = TRUE),
    error = function(e) sf::st_read(shape_file, quiet = TRUE)
  )
  iso_col <- find_column(shp, c("ISO_3_CODE", "ISO3", "ISO_A3", "ADM0_A3", "iso3"))
  if (is.null(iso_col)) return(NULL)
  shp$ISO3 <- toupper(trimws(as.character(shp[[iso_col]])))
  shp
}
map_shape <- tryCatch(get_map_shape(), error = function(e) NULL)

map_colors <- c(
  "Endémique" = "#C62828",
  "Non endémique" = "#2E7D32",
  "Endémique, surveillance indisponible" = "#F9A825",
  "Non endémique, surveillance rapportée" = "#1565C0",
  "Jamais endémique" = "#90A4AE",
  "Statut non classé" = "#6D4C41",
  "Statuts multiples" = "#6A1B9A",
  "Non renseigné" = "#E0E0E0"
)

encode_base64 <- function(bytes) {
  alphabet <- strsplit("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", "")[[1]]
  values <- as.integer(bytes)
  if (!length(values)) return("")
  padding <- (3L - length(values) %% 3L) %% 3L
  if (padding) values <- c(values, rep(0L, padding))
  groups <- matrix(values, ncol = 3L, byrow = TRUE)
  indices <- cbind(
    groups[, 1] %/% 4L,
    (groups[, 1] %% 4L) * 16L + groups[, 2] %/% 16L,
    (groups[, 2] %% 16L) * 4L + groups[, 3] %/% 64L,
    groups[, 3] %% 64L
  ) + 1L
  encoded <- matrix(alphabet[indices], ncol = 4L)
  if (padding == 1L) encoded[nrow(encoded), 4L] <- "="
  if (padding == 2L) encoded[nrow(encoded), 3:4] <- "="
  paste0(encoded[, 1], encoded[, 2], encoded[, 3], encoded[, 4], collapse = "")
}
logo_candidates <- c(params$logo_file, file.path(getwd(), "www", "logowho.png"), file.path(getwd(), "..", "www", "logowho.png"))
logo_candidates <- unique(logo_candidates[!is.na(logo_candidates) & nzchar(logo_candidates) & file.exists(logo_candidates)])
who_logo_data_uri <- if (length(logo_candidates)) {
  logo_file <- logo_candidates[1]
  logo_bytes <- readBin(logo_file, what = "raw", n = file.info(logo_file)$size)
  paste0("data:image/png;base64,", encode_base64(logo_bytes))
} else ""
export_csv_link <- function(data, filename, label) {
  if (!knitr::is_html_output() || !nrow(data)) return(invisible(NULL))
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
  utils::write.csv(data, tmp, row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na = "")
  on.exit(unlink(tmp), add = TRUE)
  bytes <- readBin(tmp, what = "raw", n = file.info(tmp)$size)
  cat(sprintf(
    '<p class="download-link"><a download="%s" href="data:text/csv;charset=utf-8;base64,%s">Télécharger %s (CSV)</a></p>',
    filename, encode_base64(bytes), label
  ))
}

report_progress_update(0.10, "Données chargées et harmonisées")
```

.report-map-settings-content label { display:block; margin:4px 0; font-weight:400; white-space:nowrap; }
.report-map-frame { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 270px; align-items:stretch; border:1px solid #e2e6e9; background:#fff; overflow:hidden; }
.report-map-frame > svg { grid-column:1; grid-row:1; width:100%; height:auto; min-height:420px; display:block; }
.report-map-region { cursor:pointer; vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke; transition:stroke .12s ease,stroke-width .12s ease; }
.report-map-region:hover,.report-map-region:focus { stroke:#000 !important; stroke-width:2.5px !important; outline:none; }
.report-map-label { font-size:9px; font-weight:600; fill:#252a2e; paint-order:stroke; stroke:#fff; stroke-width:3px; stroke-linejoin:round; text-anchor:middle; pointer-events:none; }
.report-map-leader { stroke:#333; stroke-width:.8; opacity:.9; pointer-events:none; }
.report-map-label-full { font-size:8px; font-weight:700; fill:#171717; paint-order:stroke; stroke:#fff; stroke-width:2.6px; stroke-linejoin:round; text-anchor:middle; pointer-events:none; }
.report-map-zoom { position:absolute; top:12px; left:12px; display:grid; padding:2px; border:1px solid #c6ccd0; border-radius:4px; background:#fff; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 1px 4px #26374626; }
.report-map-zoom button { width:34px; height:34px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid #d5dade; background:#fff; color:#20272c; font-size:21px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; }
.report-map-zoom button:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
.report-map-zoom button:hover { background:#f1f4f6; }
.report-map-legend { position:static; grid-column:2; grid-row:1; width:auto; max-height:none; overflow:auto; align-self:stretch; padding:12px 14px; background:#fff; border:0; border-left:1px solid #d8dde1; border-radius:0; box-shadow:none; }
.report-map-legend h5 { margin:0 0 6px; color:#25384a; font-weight:700; }
.report-map-legend-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; margin:4px 0; font-size:11px; line-height:1.25; }
.report-map-legend-swatch { flex:0 0 15px; width:15px; height:15px; border:1px solid #738995; display:inline-block; }
.report-quant-map-card { padding:0; border:0; border-radius:0; background:#fff; }
.report-quant-map-card .report-map-header { margin:0; padding:8px 10px 4px; background:#fff; }
.report-quant-map-card .report-map-header h4 { margin:0; color:#082f6b; font-size:30px; line-height:1.2; }
.report-map-subtitle { margin:0; padding:4px 10px 9px; color:#a52a2a; background:#fff; font-size:17px; line-height:1.3; }
.report-quant-map-card .report-map-frame { position:relative; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 230px; grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr); gap:8px; min-height:560px; padding:8px; border:1px solid #d9dce3; background:#fff; }
.report-quant-map-card .report-map-frame > svg { grid-column:1; grid-row:1; width:100%; max-width:none; min-height:0; height:100%; justify-self:stretch; align-self:stretch; shape-rendering:geometricPrecision; text-rendering:geometricPrecision; }
.report-quant-map-card .report-map-legend { position:absolute; z-index:5; left:10%; bottom:24px; grid-column:auto; grid-row:auto; align-self:auto; justify-self:auto; margin:0; padding:7px; width:max-content; max-width:165px; box-sizing:border-box; background:#fff; border:1px solid #d9dce3; }
.report-quant-map-card .report-map-legend h5 { font-size:12px; margin-bottom:3px; }
.report-quant-map-card .report-map-legend-item { gap:5px; font-size:10px; margin:3px 0; line-height:1.15; }
.report-quant-map-card .report-map-legend-swatch { flex-basis:13px; width:13px; height:13px; }
.report-quant-map-footer { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(220px,1fr); gap:16px 28px; margin-top:0; padding:14px 16px; color:#43586b; background:#fff; font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; }
.report-quant-map-footer p { margin:0; }
.report-quant-map-notes { display:grid; gap:8px; }
.report-quant-map-disclaimer { font-size:11px; }
.report-quant-map-credits { display:grid; align-content:start; gap:4px; }
.report-quant-map-narrative { margin:12px 0 16px; padding:10px 14px; border-left:4px solid #0784C4; background:#f3f8fb; color:#334e5c; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; }
.report-quant-map-insets { position:static; z-index:4; grid-column:2; grid-row:1; width:auto; min-width:0; display:grid; grid-template-rows:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr)); align-self:stretch; gap:7px; pointer-events:auto; }
.report-quant-map-inset { min-height:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; padding:6px 8px; overflow:hidden; background:#fff; border:1px solid #718392; box-shadow:0 1px 4px #17324d30; }
.report-quant-map-inset-title { overflow:hidden; color:#17324d; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.15; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.report-quant-map-inset svg { display:block; width:100%; height:78px; min-height:78px; overflow:visible; shape-rendering:geometricPrecision; }
.report-quant-map-inset path { stroke:#3e505c; stroke-width:1.2; stroke-linejoin:round; vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke; }
.report-status-table { min-width:560px; }
.report-status-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background:#f4f7fa; }
.report-export-tools { position:relative; display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; margin:2px 0 5px; z-index:5; }
.report-kpi .report-export-tools { display:none !important; }
.report-export-menu { position:relative; }
.report-export-menu > summary { list-style:none; width:34px; height:32px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; box-sizing:border-box; border:1px solid #c8d0d5; border-radius:3px; background:#fff; color:#66737a; cursor:pointer; }
.report-export-menu > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; }
.report-export-menu > summary:hover,.report-export-menu[open] > summary { background:#f2f5f7; color:#073E83; border-color:#073E83; }
.report-export-menu > summary svg { width:19px; height:19px; }
.report-export-options { position:absolute; right:0; top:calc(100% + 4px); display:none; min-width:100px; padding:5px; background:#fff; border:1px solid #c8d0d5; border-radius:4px; box-shadow:0 3px 10px #102a4326; }
.report-export-menu[open] .report-export-options { display:grid; gap:3px; }
.report-export-options button { color:#fff; background:#073E83; border:0; border-radius:4px; padding:6px 9px; font:inherit; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; }
.report-export-options button { text-align:left; background:#fff; color:#17324d; }
.report-export-options button:hover { background:#eaf3fa; color:#073E83; }
.report-compare-filters { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr)); gap:12px; padding:13px; background:#f4f7fa; border:1px solid #d7e1ea; margin:10px 0; }
.report-compare-filters label { display:block; font-weight:700; color:#123b5d; margin-bottom:4px; }
.report-compare-filters select { width:100%; min-height:38px; border:1px solid #9eafbd; border-radius:4px; background:#fff; padding:6px; }
.report-compare-filters select[multiple] { min-height:108px; }
.report-compare-chart-wrap { overflow:auto; border:1px solid #d7e1ea; background:#fff; }
.report-compare-chart { display:block; min-height:300px; }
.report-sex-chart-wrap { overflow:auto; border:1px solid #d7e1ea; background:#fff; }
.report-sex-stacked-chart { display:block; min-height:380px; }
.report-sex-filters select[multiple] { min-height:108px; }
.report-narrative { margin:12px 0 16px; padding:10px 14px; border-left:4px solid #0784C4; background:#f3f8fb; color:#334e5c; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; }
.report-compare-chart-title { margin:12px 16px 0; color:#123b5d; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.35; }
.report-trend-explorer-filters { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr)); gap:12px; padding:13px; background:#f4f7fa; border:1px solid #d7e1ea; margin:10px 0; }
.report-trend-explorer-filters label { display:block; font-weight:700; color:#123b5d; margin-bottom:4px; }
.report-trend-explorer-filters select { width:100%; min-height:108px; border:1px solid #9eafbd; border-radius:4px; background:#fff; padding:6px; }
.report-trend-explorer-filters select:not([multiple]) { min-height:38px; }
.report-trend-explorer-chart { width:100%; min-width:680px; height:auto; display:block; }
.report-trend-explorer-chart-wrap { overflow-x:auto; border:1px solid #d7e1ea; background:#fff; }
@media print { .report-export-tools,.report-compare-filters { display:none !important; } .report-filter-settings { display:block !important; } .report-filter-settings > summary { display:none !important; } #report-filter-panel { display:block !important; visibility:visible !important; } .report-live-panel,.report-map-card,.report-disease-chart { break-inside:avoid; } }
@media (max-width:760px) { .report-chart-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
@media (max-width:760px) { .report-map-frame { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); } .report-map-frame > svg { grid-column:1; grid-row:1; } .report-map-legend { grid-column:1; grid-row:2; max-height:220px; border-left:0; border-top:1px solid #d8dde1; } }
@media (max-width:760px) { .report-quant-map-card .report-map-frame { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); grid-template-rows:auto auto auto; min-height:0; } .report-quant-map-card .report-map-frame > svg { grid-column:1; grid-row:1; } .report-quant-map-card .report-map-legend { position:static; grid-column:1; grid-row:2; align-self:start; justify-self:start; margin:6px 0 0; } .report-quant-map-insets { grid-column:1; grid-row:3; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); grid-template-rows:none; } .report-quant-map-inset svg { height:56px; min-height:56px; } .report-quant-map-footer { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:8px; } }
.report-filter-note { color:#44545e; margin:8px 0; }
.full-reference-report { margin:26px 0; border:1px solid #d4e2eb; border-radius:8px; padding:12px 16px; }
.full-reference-report > summary { color:#123b5d; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; }
.methods-collapsible { margin:24px 0; border:1px solid #d4e2eb; border-radius:6px; background:#fff; }
.methods-collapsible > summary { padding:10px 14px; color:#123b5d; background:#eef4f8; border-left:4px solid #0784C4; font-size:22px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; }
.methods-collapsible[open] > summary { border-bottom:1px solid #d4e2eb; }
.methods-collapsible-content { padding:12px 16px; }
</style>

  const t = key => dictionary[window.ReportI18n?.language||"en"][key] ?? dictionary.en[key] ?? key;
  const setLanguage = language => {
    const selected=language==="fr"?"fr":"en";window.ReportI18n.language=selected;document.documentElement.lang=selected;
    document.title=t("reportTitle");
    const subtitle=document.querySelector(".subtitle");if(subtitle)subtitle.textContent=t("subtitle");
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]").forEach(element=>{element.textContent=t(element.dataset.i18n);});
    const sourceTable=document.getElementById("source-coverage-table");if(sourceTable){const caption=sourceTable.querySelector("caption");if(caption)caption.textContent=t("sourcesCaption");const keys=["sourceHeader","observationsHeader","diseasesHeader","indicatorsHeader","countriesHeader","firstYearHeader","lastYearHeader"];sourceTable.querySelectorAll("thead th").forEach((cell,index)=>{if(keys[index])cell.textContent=t(keys[index]);});}
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-report-language]").forEach(button=>button.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(button.dataset.reportLanguage===selected)));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("report-language-change",{detail:{language:selected}}));
  };
  window.ReportI18n = { t, language:"en", setLanguage };
  document.documentElement.lang="en";
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-report-language]").forEach(button=>button.addEventListener("click",()=>setLanguage(button.dataset.reportLanguage)));
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",()=>setLanguage("en"),{once:true});
})();

<h3 id="report-config-title" data-i18n="filterHeading">Customize the report</h3>

<p data-i18n="filterIntro">Les filtres ci-dessous agissent directement dans ce fichier HTML. Les maladies, les indicateurs et les années sont tous sélectionnés au départ. Les indicateurs proposés sont recalculés selon les maladies choisies.</p>

```{r donnees-filtres-navigateur, results='asis'}
browser_data <- df[, c("source", "disease", "indicator", "indicator_code",
                       "year", "country", "country_iso", "value",
                       "ntd_all_ages_ntd_female", "ntd_all_ages_ntd_male",
                       "ntd_all_ages_ntd_unknown_both_sexes",
                       "endemicity_status", "is_endemicity", "performance"), drop = FALSE]
if (is.data.frame(country_lookup) && all(c("ISO3", "Name") %in% names(country_lookup))) {
  missing_iso <- is.na(browser_data$country_iso) | !nzchar(trimws(browser_data$country_iso))
  browser_data$country_iso[missing_iso] <- as.character(country_lookup$ISO3[
    match(normalize_country(browser_data$country[missing_iso]), normalize_country(country_lookup$Name))
  ])
}
browser_json <- as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(
  browser_data, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null"
))
browser_json_b64 <- encode_base64(charToRaw(enc2utf8(browser_json)))
cat('<script type="application/octet-stream" id="report-data-b64">',
    browser_json_b64, '</script>\n', sep = "")
browser_map_paths <- list()
if (!is.null(map_shape) && nrow(map_shape) > 0L) {
  africa_albers <- sf::st_crs("+proj=aea +lat_1=20 +lat_2=-23 +lat_0=0 +lon_0=25 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs +type=crs")
  map_layer <- sf::st_transform(map_shape, africa_albers)
  map_name_col <- find_column(map_layer, c("ADMIN", "NAME", "NAME_0", "COUNTRY", "COUNTRY_NAME", "NAME_EN"))
  map_layer$MAP_LABEL <- if (!is.null(map_name_col)) as.character(map_layer[[map_name_col]]) else if (is.data.frame(country_lookup) && all(c("ISO3", "Name") %in% names(country_lookup))) as.character(country_lookup$Name[match(toupper(map_layer$ISO3), toupper(country_lookup$ISO3))]) else as.character(map_layer$ISO3)
  missing_labels <- is.na(map_layer$MAP_LABEL) | !nzchar(trimws(map_layer$MAP_LABEL))
  map_layer$MAP_LABEL[missing_labels] <- as.character(map_layer$ISO3[missing_labels])
  map_scale <- 1e-4
  map_label_positions <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(ggplot2::ggplot_build(
      ggplot2::ggplot(map_layer) + ggplot2::geom_sf_text(ggplot2::aes(label = MAP_LABEL), size = 3)
    )$data[[1]]),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  browser_map_paths <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(map_layer)), function(i) {
    coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_geometry(map_layer[i, ]))
    feature_x <- coordinates[, "X"] * map_scale
    feature_y <- -coordinates[, "Y"] * map_scale
    ring_cols <- intersect(c("L1", "L2"), colnames(coordinates))
    ring_key <- if (length(ring_cols)) {
      do.call(paste, c(as.data.frame(coordinates[, ring_cols, drop = FALSE]), sep = "_"))
    } else rep("1", nrow(coordinates))
    paths <- lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(coordinates)), ring_key), function(idx) {
      xy <- coordinates[idx, , drop = FALSE]
      x <- xy[, "X"] * map_scale
      y <- -xy[, "Y"] * map_scale
      paste0("M", sprintf("%.3f,%.3f", x[1], y[1]),
             paste0("L", sprintf("%.3f,%.3f", x[-1], y[-1]), collapse = ""), "Z")
    })
    point <- if (!is.null(map_label_positions) && nrow(map_label_positions) >= i && all(c("x", "y") %in% names(map_label_positions))) {
      c(X = map_label_positions$x[i], Y = map_label_positions$y[i])
    } else tryCatch(sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_point_on_surface(sf::st_geometry(map_layer[i, ])))[1, ], error = function(e) c(X = mean(coordinates[, "X"]), Y = mean(coordinates[, "Y"])))
    label_x <- unname(point["X"] * map_scale)
    label_y <- unname(-point["Y"] * map_scale)
    list(iso = as.character(map_layer$ISO3[i]), name = as.character(map_layer$MAP_LABEL[i]),
         x = label_x, y = label_y,
         bbox = list(xmin = min(feature_x, na.rm = TRUE), ymin = min(feature_y, na.rm = TRUE),
                     xmax = max(feature_x, na.rm = TRUE), ymax = max(feature_y, na.rm = TRUE)),
         path = paste(unlist(paths), collapse = ""))
  })
}
map_json <- as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(browser_map_paths, auto_unbox = TRUE))
map_json_b64 <- encode_base64(charToRaw(enc2utf8(map_json)))
cat('<script type="application/octet-stream" id="report-map-b64">',
    map_json_b64, '</script>\n', sep = "")

```

<script>
(() => {
  try {
  const encoded = document.getElementById("report-data-b64").textContent.trim();
  const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(encoded), ch => ch.charCodeAt(0));
  const rows = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(bytes));
  const mapEncoded = document.getElementById("report-map-b64").textContent.trim();
  const mapBytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(mapEncoded), ch => ch.charCodeAt(0));
  const mapFeatures = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(mapBytes));
  const t = key => window.ReportI18n?.t(key) ?? key;
  const language = () => window.ReportI18n?.language||"en";
  const runView = (elementId, callback) => {
    try { callback(); }
    catch (error) {
      console.error(`TVD report view failed: ${elementId}`, error);
      const root=document.getElementById(elementId);
      if(root){root.replaceChildren();root.textContent=`${t("viewUnavailable")} (${error.message||error})`;}
    }
  };
  const numberText = (value, options={}) => Number(value).toLocaleString(language()==="en"?"en-GB":"fr-FR", options);
  const indicatorDisplayLabel = value => {const label=text(value),separator=label.indexOf(" - ");return separator>=0?label.slice(separator+3):label;};
  const statusText = status => ({
    "Endémique":t("endemic"), "Non endémique":t("nonEndemic"),
    "Endémique, surveillance indisponible":t("endemicNoSurveillance"),

    return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" width="${width}" height="${height}" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}"><foreignObject width="100%" height="100%"><div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" style="background:#fff;padding:8px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible"><style>${embeddedStyles()} .report-export-tools,.report-map-zoom,.report-map-header>details{display:none!important}</style>${content}</div></foreignObject></svg>`;
  };
  const exportExcel=(element,name)=>{
    const rows=exportRowsFor(element),columns=Math.max(1,...rows.map(row=>row.length)),title=escapeHtml(exportTitleFor(element)),sourceTable=element.tagName==="TABLE"?element:element.querySelector("table"),sourceRows=[...(sourceTable?.tBodies[0]?.rows||[])],html=`<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>body{font-family:Calibri,Arial,sans-serif;color:#263746}table{border-collapse:collapse;border:1px solid #cbd8e3}td,th{border:1px solid #dbe3e9;padding:6px 9px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}th{background:#073E83;color:#fff;font-weight:bold}.title{background:#eaf2f8;color:#123b5d;font-size:16px;font-weight:bold;padding:9px}.row-alt{background:#f3f7fa}</style></head><body><table><thead><tr><th class="title" colspan="${columns}">${title}</th></tr><tr>${(rows[0]||[]).map(value=>`<th>${escapeHtml(value)}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.slice(1).map((row,index)=>`<tr class="${index%2?"row-alt":""}">${row.map((value,column)=>{const cell=sourceRows[index]?.cells[column],fill=cell?.style.backgroundColor,color=cell?.style.color,font=cell?.style.fontWeight;const style=fill||color||font?` style="${fill?`background-color:${escapeHtml(fill)};`:""}${color?`color:${escapeHtml(color)};`:""}${font?`font-weight:${escapeHtml(font)};`:""}"`:"";return `<td${style}>${escapeHtml(value)}</td>`;}).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table></body></html>`;

    const isMap=element.classList?.contains("report-map-card"),isHeatmap=element.classList?.contains("report-heatmap"),isTable=element.tagName==="TABLE",heatmapLegend=document.getElementById("report-heatmap-legend")?.outerHTML||"",content=isMap||isTable&&!isHeatmap?element.outerHTML:elementSvg(element),bodyContent=isMap?content:isHeatmap?`<main class="export-sheet"><h1>${escapeHtml(title)}</h1>${heatmapLegend}${element.outerHTML}</main>`:`<main class="export-sheet"><h1>${escapeHtml(title)}</h1>${content}</main>`;
    win.document.open();win.document.write(`<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${escapeHtml(name)}</title><style>${embeddedStyles()}@page{size:A4 landscape;margin:12mm}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;padding:12px;background:#fff;color:#263746;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}.export-sheet{width:100%;border:1px solid #d7e1ea;border-radius:5px;padding:14px;background:#fff}h1{margin:0 0 14px;color:#123b5d;font-size:20px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:10px}thead{display:table-header-group}tr{break-inside:avoid}th,td{padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #dbe3e9;text-align:left}th{background:#073E83!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#f3f7fa!important;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}.report-heatmap{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;table-layout:fixed;font-size:7px}.report-heatmap th,.report-heatmap td{min-width:0!important;padding:3px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.report-heatmap th:first-child,.report-heatmap td:first-child{width:145px}.report-heatmap td{height:auto;font-size:7px;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}.report-heatmap-legend{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 12px;margin:0 0 10px;padding:8px;background:#f3f8fb;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}.report-heatmap-legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:9px}.report-heatmap-swatch{width:12px;height:12px;print-color-adjust:exact;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact}.report-export-tools,.report-map-zoom,.report-map-header>details{display:none!important}.report-map-card{width:100%;break-inside:avoid}svg{max-width:100%;height:auto}</style></head><body>${bodyContent}</body></html>`);win.document.close();setTimeout(()=>{win.focus();win.print();},500);
  };
  const exportElement=(element,format)=>{
    const target=element.closest(".report-map-card")||element;
    const heading=exportTitleFor(target),name=safeName(heading);

    if(format==="PDF"){exportPdf(target,name,heading);return;}
    const svgText=elementSvg(target),blob=new Blob([svgText],{type:"image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"});

    const image=new Image(),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);image.onload=()=>{const canvas=document.createElement("canvas"),scale=Math.min(4,12000/Math.max(image.width,image.height));canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(image.width*scale));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(image.height*scale));const context=canvas.getContext("2d");if(!context){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);window.alert("Le navigateur ne peut pas préparer cette image.   };
  const addTrendExportTools=(container,getTarget)=>{

    menu.append(toggle,options);toolsNode.appendChild(menu);container.appendChild(toolsNode);

    return true;

  const removeExportTools=element=>{
    element._exportTools?.remove();

    element.dataset.exportReady="0";
  };
  const addExportTools=element=>{
    if(!hasExportData(element)){removeExportTools(element);return;}
    if(element.dataset.exportReady==="1")return;element.dataset.exportReady="1";
    const toolsNode=document.createElement("div");toolsNode.className="report-export-tools";
    const mapCard=element.closest(".report-map-card");
    const menu=document.createElement("details");menu.className="report-export-menu";
    const toggle=document.createElement("summary");toggle.title="Exporter cette vue";toggle.setAttribute("aria-label","Ouvrir les formats d’exportation");
    toggle.innerHTML=mapCard?'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="currentColor"><circle cx="12" cy="5" r="1.8"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.8"/><circle cx="12" cy="19" r="1.8"/></svg>':'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3v12m0 0 4-4m-4 4-4-4"/><path d="M4 17v3h16v-3"/></svg>';
    const options=document.createElement("div");options.className="report-export-options";
    ["PNG","SVG","PDF","Excel"].forEach(format=>{const button=document.createElement("button");button.type="button";button.textContent=format;button.title=`Exporter en ${format}`;button.addEventListener("click",()=>{exportElement(element,format);menu.open=false;});options.appendChild(button);});
    menu.append(toggle,options);toolsNode.appendChild(menu);
    element._exportTools=toolsNode;
    if(mapCard)mapCard.querySelector(".report-map-header").appendChild(toolsNode);
    else if(element.classList.contains("report-kpi"))element.appendChild(toolsNode);
    else if(element.tagName==="TABLE"&&element.parentElement.classList.contains("report-live-table-wrap"))element.parentElement.parentElement.insertBefore(toolsNode,element.parentElement);
    else element.parentElement.insertBefore(toolsNode,element);
  };
  const decorateExports=()=>document.querySelectorAll(".report-live-table-wrap table:not(.report-trend-table),#report-highlights table,.report-heatmap,.report-map-card svg,#report-country-comparison,#report-sex-stacked-chart").forEach(addExportTools);
  const render = (skipMaps=false) => {
    const active = Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(ids).map(key => [key, selected(key)]));
    const filtered = rows.filter(row => matches(row, "disease", active.disease) &&
      matches(row, "indicator", active.indicator) && matches(row, "country", active.country) &&
      matches(row, "year", active.year) && matches(row, "source", active.source));
    const highlights=document.getElementById("report-highlights");highlights.replaceChildren();
    const normalizeProgramText=value=>text(value).normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g," ").trim();
    const programTargetForDisease=(disease,indicator="")=>{
      const diseaseKey=normalizeProgramText(disease),combined=`${diseaseKey} ${normalizeProgramText(indicator)}`;
      if(/human african trypanosomiasis|rhodesiense|gambiense|r ?hat|g ?hat/.test(combined)){
        if(/rhodesiense|r ?hat/.test(combined))return "elimination_php";
        if(/gambiense|g ?hat/.test(combined))return "elimination_transmission";
      }
      if(/chagas/.test(diseaseKey)||/lymphatic filariasis/.test(diseaseKey)||/malaria/.test(diseaseKey)||/visceral leishmaniasis|leishmaniasis visceral/.test(diseaseKey))return "elimination_php";
      if(/leprosy|onchocerciasis/.test(diseaseKey))return "elimination_transmission";
      if(/dracunculiasis|guinea worm|yaws/.test(diseaseKey))return "eradication";
      if(/buruli ulcer|chikungunya|dengue|echinococcosis|foodborne trematod|cutaneous leishmaniasis|leishmaniasis cutaneous|mycetoma|chromoblastomycosis|deep mycos|noma|scabies|ectoparasitos|snakebite|envenoming|taeniasis|cysticercosis/.test(diseaseKey))return "control";
      if(/leishmaniasis/.test(combined)&&/cutaneous/.test(combined))return "control";
      if(/leishmaniasis/.test(combined)&&/visceral/.test(combined))return "elimination_php";
      return null;
    };
    const programmeTargets=[["control","controlTarget"],["elimination_php","eliminationPhpTarget"],["elimination_transmission","eliminationTransmissionTarget"],["eradication","eradicationTarget"]];
    const targetCountrySets=new Map(programmeTargets.map(([key])=>[key,new Set()])),countryNames=new Map();
    filtered.filter(row=>!row.is_endemicity&&row.value!=null&&text(row.value)!==""&&Number.isFinite(Number(row.value))).forEach(row=>{
      const target=programTargetForDisease(row.disease,row.indicator);if(!targetCountrySets.has(target))return;
      const country=text(row.country_iso).trim().toUpperCase()||normalizeProgramText(row.country),name=text(row.country);if(!country)return;
      targetCountrySets.get(target).add(country);if(name)countryNames.set(country,name);
    });
    const reductionGroups=new Map(),reductionIndicator=/incidence|prevalence|morbidity|mortality|deaths?|new cases?|clinical cases?|confirmed cases?|suspected cases?|reported cases?/;
    filtered.filter(row=>!row.is_endemicity&&row.value!=null&&text(row.value)!==""&&Number.isFinite(Number(row.value))&&Number.isFinite(Number(row.year))&&programTargetForDisease(row.disease,row.indicator)==="control"&&reductionIndicator.test(normalizeProgramText(`${row.indicator} ${row.indicator_code}`))).forEach(row=>{
      const disease=text(row.disease),indicator=text(row.indicator),country=text(row.country_iso).trim().toUpperCase()||normalizeProgramText(row.country),key=`${disease}\u0000${indicator}`;
      if(!disease||!country)return;if(text(row.country))countryNames.set(country,text(row.country));
      if(!reductionGroups.has(key))reductionGroups.set(key,{disease,years:new Map()});
      const group=reductionGroups.get(key),year=Number(row.year);if(!group.years.has(year))group.years.set(year,new Map());
      const countryValues=group.years.get(year);countryValues.set(country,(countryValues.get(country)||0)+Number(row.value));
    });
    const progressDiseases=new Map();
    reductionGroups.forEach(group=>{
      const years=[...group.years.keys()].sort((a,b)=>a-b);if(years.length<2)return;
      const first=group.years.get(years[0]),last=group.years.get(years[years.length-1]),commonCountries=[...first.keys()].filter(country=>last.has(country));if(!commonCountries.length)return;
      const initial=commonCountries.reduce((sum,country)=>sum+first.get(country),0),final=commonCountries.reduce((sum,country)=>sum+last.get(country),0);
      if(final<initial)progressDiseases.set(normalizeProgramText(group.disease),group.disease);
    });
    const sortedCountryList=countries=>[...countries].map(code=>countryNames.get(code)||code).sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,language()==="en"?"en":"fr"));
    const programmeCounts=new Map(programmeTargets.map(([target])=>[target,targetCountrySets.get(target).size]));
    const kpiDefinitions=[
      ["control",programmeCounts.get("control"),t("kpiControlCountries")],
      ["elimination_php",programmeCounts.get("elimination_php"),t("kpiEliminationPhpCountries")],
      ["elimination_transmission",programmeCounts.get("elimination_transmission"),t("kpiEliminationTransmissionCountries")],
      ["eradication",programmeCounts.get("eradication"),t("kpiEradicationCountries")],
      ["reduction",progressDiseases.size,t("kpiReductionDiseases")]
    ];
    const kpiRoot=document.getElementById("report-live-kpis");kpiRoot.replaceChildren();
    kpiDefinitions.forEach(([key,value,label])=>{const card=document.createElement("div");card.className=`report-kpi report-kpi-${key}`;card._exportRows=[[label,numberText(value)]];const strong=document.createElement("strong");strong.textContent=numberText(value);card.append(strong,document.createTextNode(label));kpiRoot.appendChild(card);});
    const table=document.createElement("table");table.className="report-live-table";
    const thead=table.createTHead().insertRow();[t("programTargetHeader"),t("reportedCountHeader"),t("countriesConcernedHeader")].forEach(label=>{const th=document.createElement("th");th.textContent=label;thead.appendChild(th);});
    const tbody=table.createTBody();
    const addGroupRow=label=>{const tr=tbody.insertRow();tr.className="report-highlight-heading";const th=document.createElement("th");th.colSpan=3;th.textContent=label;tr.appendChild(th);};
    const addDataRow=(label,count,countries,key)=>{const tr=tbody.insertRow();tr.appendChild(makeCell(label));const countCell=makeCell(count);countCell.classList.add("report-highlight-count",`report-highlight-count-${key}`);tr.appendChild(countCell);const countryCell=makeCell(countries.length?countries.join(", "):"—");countryCell.classList.add("report-highlight-countries");tr.appendChild(countryCell);};
    addGroupRow(t("reportingCountriesGroup"));
    programmeTargets.forEach(([target,labelKey])=>addDataRow(t(labelKey),numberText(programmeCounts.get(target)),sortedCountryList(targetCountrySets.get(target)),target));
    addGroupRow(t("reductionProgressGroup"));
    addDataRow(t("reductionProgressResult"),numberText(progressDiseases.size),[...progressDiseases.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,language()==="en"?"en":"fr")),"reduction");
    highlights.appendChild(table);
    const summary = Object.keys(ids).map(key => `${labels[key]}: ${active[key].length ? active[key].length : (language()==="en"?"all":"toutes")}`).join(" · ");
    document.getElementById("report-filter-summary").textContent = `${t("filterSummary")} — ${summary}`;
    runView("report-trend-reading",()=>renderTrendReading(filtered));
    runView("report-disease-trends",()=>renderTrendCharts(filtered));
    const diseaseUniverse=unique(rows.map(row=>row.disease));
    const mapDiseases=active.disease.length?active.disease:diseaseUniverse;
    const mapRows=rows.filter(row=>matches(row,"disease",mapDiseases)&&matches(row,"country",active.country)&&matches(row,"year",active.year)&&matches(row,"source",active.source));
    // The endemicity summary follows every report filter, including indicators.
    const endemicitySummaryRows=mapRows.filter(row=>matches(row,"indicator",active.indicator));
    const filterSelectedIsos=new Set();
    if(active.country.length===1){
      const selectedCountry=active.country[0];
      rows.filter(row=>text(row.country)===selectedCountry&&text(row.country_iso)).forEach(row=>filterSelectedIsos.add(text(row.country_iso).trim().toUpperCase()));
    }
    const latest = new Map();
    endemicitySummaryRows.filter(row => row.is_endemicity && text(row.endemicity_status)).forEach(row => {
      const diseaseGroup=endemicityColumnGroup(row),diseaseKey=diseaseGroup?.key||`disease:${text(row.disease).toLowerCase()}`,diseaseLabel=diseaseGroup?.label||text(row.disease);
      const key = `${text(row.country_iso).toUpperCase()}\u0000${text(row.country)}\u0000${diseaseKey}`;
      updateLatestStatus(latest,key,row,{country:text(row.country),iso:text(row.country_iso),disease:diseaseLabel,diseaseGroupKey:diseaseKey});
    });
    const latestRows = [...latest.values()].sort((a, b) => a.disease.localeCompare(b.disease) || a.country.localeCompare(b.country));
    const statusGroups=new Map();latestRows.forEach(row=>{const key=`${row.disease}\u0000${row.status}`;statusGroups.set(key,(statusGroups.get(key)||0)+1);});
    const statusSummary=[...statusGroups.entries()].map(([key,count])=>{const [disease,status]=key.split("\u0000");return[disease,status,count];}).sort((a,b)=>String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0]))||String(a[1]).localeCompare(String(b[1])));
    const statusRoot=document.getElementById("report-status-summary"),statusPanel=statusRoot.closest(".report-live-panel");
    statusPanel.hidden=statusSummary.length===0;statusRoot.replaceChildren();
    if(statusSummary.length){const statusTable=makeTable(statusSummary.map(([disease,status,count])=>[disease,statusText(status),count]),["Maladie","Dernier statut disponible","Nombre de pays"]);statusTable.classList.add("report-status-table");statusRoot.appendChild(statusTable);}
    if(!skipMaps)runView("report-endemicity-maps",()=>renderMaps(mapRows,mapDiseases,filterSelectedIsos));
    const allDiseaseOptions=unique(rows.map(row=>row.disease));
    const allDiseases=!active.disease.length||active.disease.length===allDiseaseOptions.length;
    const heatmapRows=rows.filter(row=>matches(row,"country",active.country)&&matches(row,"year",active.year)&&matches(row,"source",active.source));
    runView("report-heatmap",()=>renderHeatmap(heatmapRows,allDiseases));
    const detail = document.getElementById("report-detail-body"); detail.replaceChildren();
    filtered.slice(0, 2000).forEach(row => {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      [row.source, row.disease, row.indicator, row.year, row.country,
       row.value == null ? "—" : numberText(row.value), row.is_endemicity?statusText(statusClass(row.endemicity_status)):row.endemicity_status]
        .forEach(value => tr.appendChild(makeCell(value)));
      detail.appendChild(tr);
    });
    document.getElementById("report-row-count").textContent = filtered.length > 2000
      ? `${numberText(filtered.length)} ${t("rowLimit")}`
      : `${numberText(filtered.length)} ${t("rowCount")}`;
    decorateExports();
  };
  const populateIndicators = () => {
    const diseases = selected("disease");
    const choices = unique(rows.filter(row => !diseases.length || diseases.includes(text(row.disease)))
      .map(row => row.indicator));
    fill("indicator", choices, true);
  };
  const populateSources = () => {
    const sourceSelect=document.getElementById(ids.source),previous=selected("source"),previousCount=sourceSelect.options.length;
    const wasAll=!previousCount||!previous.length||previous.length===previousCount;
    const diseases=selected("disease"),indicators=selected("indicator");
    const choices=unique(rows.filter(row=>(!diseases.length||diseases.includes(text(row.disease)))&&(!indicators.length||indicators.includes(text(row.indicator)))).map(row=>row.source));
    fill("source",choices,false);
    [...sourceSelect.options].forEach(option=>{option.selected=wasAll||previous.includes(option.value);});
  };
  fill("disease", unique(rows.map(row => row.disease)), true);
  fill("country", unique(rows.map(row => row.country)), true);
  fill("year", unique(rows.map(row => row.year)), true);

  populateSources();
  initializeTrendExplorer();
  initializeSexStackedChart();
  const compareDiseases=unique(rows.map(row=>row.disease));setChoices("compare-disease",compareDiseases,compareDiseases[0]);
  const compareCountries=document.getElementById("compare-country");compareCountries.replaceChildren(...unique(rows.map(row=>row.country)).map(country=>{const option=document.createElement("option");option.value=country;option.textContent=country;option.selected=true;return option;}));
  updateCompareIndicators();
  initializeQuantitativeMap();
  document.getElementById("compare-disease").addEventListener("change",()=>{updateCompareIndicators();renderCountryComparison();decorateExports();});
  document.getElementById("compare-indicator").addEventListener("change",()=>{renderCountryComparison();decorateExports();});
  document.getElementById("compare-country").addEventListener("change",()=>{renderCountryComparison();decorateExports();});
  window.addEventListener("report-language-change",()=>{render(true);renderTrendExplorer();renderCountryComparison();window.refreshSexStackedChart?.();renderQuantitativeMap();decorateExports();});

  document.getElementById(ids.disease).addEventListener("change", () => { populateIndicators(); populateSources(); render(); });
  document.getElementById(ids.indicator).addEventListener("change", () => { populateSources(); render(); });
  Object.keys(ids).filter(key => key !== "disease"&&key!=="indicator").forEach(key => document.getElementById(ids[key]).addEventListener("change", render));
  document.getElementById("filter-reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
    Object.keys(ids).forEach(key => [...document.getElementById(ids[key]).options].forEach(option => { option.selected = true; }));
    populateIndicators(); populateSources(); render();
  });
  runView("report-country-comparison",renderCountryComparison);
  render();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("TVD report initialization failed", error);
    const notice = document.createElement("div");
    notice.className = "report-js-error";
    notice.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    notice.textContent = "Le rapport interactif n’a pas pu démarrer : " + (error && error.message ? error.message : error);
    document.getElementById("report-config-title")?.after(notice);
  }
})();
</script>

<details class="methods-collapsible">
<summary><span data-i18n="methodsHeading">Méthodes, sources, définitions et limites</span></summary>
<div class="methods-collapsible-content" markdown="1">

<h3 data-i18n="methodsTitle">Méthodes</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong data-i18n="methodsExtraction">Extraction et harmonisation.</strong> <span data-i18n="methodsExtractionA">Le rapport interroge la table</span> <strong><code>`r params$table_name`</code></strong> <span data-i18n="methodsExtractionB">de la base SQLite. Les noms de champs sont harmonisés afin de reconnaître les variantes présentes dans la base.</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="methodsSeparation">Séparation des produits.</strong> <span data-i18n="methodsSeparationBody">Les filtres transmis par l’application sont appliqués séparément aux tableaux généraux, aux tendances, à la géographie et à l’endémicité.</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="methodsEndemicity">Endémicité.</strong> <span data-i18n="methodsEndemicityBody">Pour chaque couple pays-maladie, le rapport retient le statut de l’année numérique la plus récente. Lorsque plusieurs statuts différents existent pour le même pays, la modalité « Statuts multiples » est affichée.</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="methodsTrends">Tendances.</strong> <span data-i18n="methodsTrendsBody">Les lignes d’endémicité sont exclues. Les valeurs quantitatives sont agrégées par maladie, indicateur et année avec une somme. Les tableaux sont ensuite pivotés pour présenter les années en colonnes.</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="methodsVariations">Variations.</strong> <span data-i18n="methodsVariationsBody">Pour chaque indicateur, les écarts sont calculés entre la première et la dernière année disponibles. Ces années peuvent différer d’un indicateur à l’autre.</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="methodsMapping">Cartographie.</strong> <span data-i18n="methodsMappingBody">La jointure géographique utilise d’abord le code ISO3 présent dans les données, puis la table localisation par normalisation des noms de pays lorsque le code est absent.</span></li>
</ol>

<h3 data-i18n="sourcesTitle">Sources</h3>

```{r sources-methodes}
source_table <- df_table |>
  dplyr::group_by(source) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Observations = dplyr::n(),
    Maladies = dplyr::n_distinct(disease),
    Indicateurs = dplyr::n_distinct(indicator_code[indicator_code != "Sans code"]),
    Pays = dplyr::n_distinct(country[country != "Non renseigné"]),
    Premiere_annee = if (all(is.na(year_numeric))) NA_real_ else min(year_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    Derniere_annee = if (all(is.na(year_numeric))) NA_real_ else max(year_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Observations))
knitr::kable(source_table, col.names = c("Source", "Observations", "Diseases", "Indicators", "Countries", "First year", "Last year"), caption = "Coverage of sources in selected data", table.attr = 'id="source-coverage-table"')
```

<p><span data-i18n="sourcesBodyA">Les valeurs quantitatives sont recherchées successivement dans</span> <code>all_cases</code>, <code>total_value</code>, <code>value</code> ou <code>numeric_value</code>. <span data-i18n="sourcesBodyB">Les statuts d’endémicité proviennent de</span> <code>status_endemicite</code> <span data-i18n="sourcesBodyC">ou, à défaut, de</span> <code>status_raw</code>.</p>

<h3 data-i18n="definitionsTitle">Définitions opérationnelles</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong data-i18n="definitionEndemicLabel">Endémique :</strong> <span data-i18n="definitionEndemicBody">statut commençant par « Yes, country is endemic ».</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="definitionNonEndemicLabel">Non endémique :</strong> <span data-i18n="definitionNonEndemicBody">statut commençant par « No, country is not endemic ».</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="definitionSurveillanceLabel">Endémique, surveillance indisponible :</strong> <span data-i18n="definitionSurveillanceBody">statut indiquant que le pays est connu comme endémique, mais que les données de surveillance ne sont pas disponibles.</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="definitionReportedLabel">Valeur rapportée :</strong> <span data-i18n="definitionReportedBody">somme des valeurs numériques des lignes correspondant à une même maladie, un même indicateur et une même année après application des filtres.</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="definitionAbsoluteLabel">Écart absolu :</strong> <span data-i18n="definitionAbsoluteBody">différence entre la dernière valeur disponible et la première valeur disponible.</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="definitionRelativeLabel">Écart relatif :</strong> <span data-i18n="definitionRelativeBody">écart absolu divisé par la valeur initiale en valeur absolue, puis multiplié par 100.</span></li>
<li><strong data-i18n="definitionLatestLabel">Dernier statut disponible :</strong> <span data-i18n="definitionLatestBody">statut associé à l’année numérique la plus récente pour le couple pays-maladie.</span></li>
</ul>

<h3 data-i18n="limitationsTitle">Limites d’interprétation</h3>
<ul>
<li data-i18n="limitSums">Les sommes décrivent les valeurs enregistrées dans les lignes retenues. Elles ne constituent pas automatiquement des taux, des incidences ou des prévalences standardisées.</li>
<li data-i18n="limitIndicators">Les indicateurs de nature différente ne doivent pas être additionnés pour une interprétation clinique ou programmatique. Les agrégats toutes indications confondues servent uniquement de repères descriptifs.</li>
<li data-i18n="limitIncrease">Une hausse peut refléter une augmentation réelle, une amélioration du dépistage, une extension géographique du rapportage ou une meilleure complétude.</li>
<li data-i18n="limitYears">Les écarts entre années extrêmes ne décrivent pas les fluctuations intermédiaires et ne sont comparables que si les définitions, les unités et la couverture du rapportage sont restées stables.</li>
<li data-i18n="limitRelative">Lorsque la valeur initiale est nulle, l’écart relatif n’est pas défini et est affiché par un tiret.</li>
<li data-i18n="limitEndemicity">L’absence de statut d’endémicité ne signifie pas nécessairement l’absence de transmission.</li>
<li data-i18n="limitMap">La carte dépend de la disponibilité du GeoPackage, de la présence d’un code ISO3 reconnu et de la qualité de la correspondance des noms de pays.</li>
<li data-i18n="limitMissing">Les valeurs manquantes ne sont pas imputées.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</details>

```{r finalisation, include=FALSE}
report_progress_update(1, "Rapport prêt")
```
